dct_description_sm: The purpose of this data set is to share my proposed doctoral research with other reseachers in the circumpolar North who are exploring issues of sustainable natural resources, in particular water resource development, social-economic impacts, and globalization, including indigenous issues of sustainable natural resource development, international and national resource policies, and dam resistance movements.
